verdict.rationale: Square AI (Beta) is a documented in-product assistant that lets sellers ask natural-language questions over their sales/inventory data, pull insights, and handle routine tasks, matching the delegation-to-a-built-in-assistant story. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing page and testimonials, and clearer detail on the scope of 'tasks' it can autonomously execute versus just answering questions.
